pr_title: Fix some image attachments in comments not loading in game
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/30791
- [x] Depends on https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/pull/6433
- [x] Depends on web deployment with https://github.com/ppy/osu-web/pull/11686

End result can be tested by viewing comments such as [this one](https://osu.ppy.sh/comments/2537181), where previously the game will not load such images, but now it should.

I was initially going to implement this locally in `OsuMarkdownImage`s (more or less similar to how osu-web did it), but I figured it would be a more solid approach to cover the entire `OnlineStore` layer instead, since the end goal is to avoid looking up resources from third-party links.
pr_comments:
As per https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/30866#discussion_r1855829985, resource lookups from external websites are now blocked (with reasonably loud warning logs), and an exception is given to osu! markdown images which are used by comments, wiki, and future overlays to come such as beatmap discussions and news.

The warning logs can turn into errors to grab our attention via sentry, but perhaps that's an overkill.

> resource lookups from external websites are now blocked (with reasonably loud warning logs)

Did you test changelogs? Specifically on production? I have a suspicion they would be broken by this.

Huh, I thought changelogs have been using markdown already. Thankfully it doesn't do any kind of online link lookups so it's not broken by this.

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/d179fe3d96919ed33105d0f489c3bbbda23dd721/osu.Game/Overlays/Changelog/ChangelogEntry.cs#L187-L198
I meant *images embedded in changelogs*...? Are you saying those just don't display?
Yes, the code above shows that everything in the changelogs is being treated as text and nothing but that.
Am I hallucinating or did images used to be a thing on the changelog overlay?

> Am I hallucinating or did images used to be a thing on the changelog overlay?

Well there's https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/12465, which is probably a definite proof that we never had support for it in the first place.

issue_context.title: Image attachments hosted in `s-ul.eu` do not show in game
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

Open in-game beatmap listing --> go to a beatmap comment w/ image or gif

[Beatmap ](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/2264468#osu/4820866)in my example

### Screenshots or videos

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5ec9df90-55bf-40fa-ae8f-4341e25bda0c)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6a598e98-052f-4ed7-91dc-49cda0cba4f8)


### Version

2024.1115.3-lazer

### Logs

[compressed-logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17827833/compressed-logs.zip)
comments:
Both of these shown on the screenshot are gifs.

Support for gif display [has been considered out of scope](https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/14417#issuecomment-902912900) previously. Not sure if anything changed.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e6fa950d-e323-445c-896d-1c19f11b3f5e)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/67d2f2a5-7812-428a-b6f2-d2f15d0f889c)

Here's an [example ](https://osu.ppy.sh/comments/2537181)with images. 


Another [one](https://osu.ppy.sh/comments/3276232). Not sure if these are secretly gifs, since other images load fine.
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/69a9b0ec-bb57-4df9-95ee-8f1f0ea0a397)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5131383-67b5-4a20-9350-f87b301696d1)
Emoji support is a different matter entirely, not one that should be in this thread.

Both of the examples you attached above contain images hosted on the s-ul.eu domain. Those fail the SSL handshake, therefore not loading in the game:
```
[network] 2024-11-24 08:38:13 [verbose]: Request to https://prdec.s-ul.eu/eiU27EFf.jpg failed with System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException: The SSL connection could not be established, see inner exception.
[network] 2024-11-24 08:38:13 [verbose]: ---> System.Security.Authentication.AuthenticationException: Authentication failed, see inner exception.
[network] 2024-11-24 08:38:13 [verbose]: ---> Interop+AppleCrypto+SslException: handshake failure
[network] 2024-11-24 08:38:13 [verbose]: --- End of inner exception stack trace ---
[network] 2024-11-24 08:38:13 [verbose]: at System.Net.Security.SslStream.ForceAuthenticationAsync[TIOAdapter](Boolean receiveFirst, Byte[] reAuthenticationData, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
[network] 2024-11-24 08:38:13 [verbose]: at System.Net.Http.ConnectHelper.EstablishSslConnectionAsync(SslClientAuthenticationOptions sslOptions, HttpRequestMessage request, Boolean async, Stream stream, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
```

This can also be confirmed in the logs you have attached:
```
2024-11-20 08:52:59 [verbose]: Request to https://ashi.s-ul.eu/A8lGZMuj failed with System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException: The SSL connection could not be established, see inner exception.
2024-11-20 08:52:59 [verbose]: ---> System.Security.Authentication.AuthenticationException: Authentication failed because the remote party sent a TLS alert: 'HandshakeFailure'.
2024-11-20 08:52:59 [verbose]: ---> System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception (0x80090326): The message received was unexpected or badly formatted.
2024-11-20 08:52:59 [verbose]: --- End of inner exception stack trace ---
```

may need @ppy/team-client attention since s-ul.eu is commonly used by the osu! community as far my quick google and discord searches go, although I'm not quite sure what can be done from our side to fix this (other than to figure out how it still loads on osu-web and in browsers in general).
No image should ever be requested directly from a third party domain. What the hell is going on here?? @ppy/team-web are comment images not being proxied?

oh yeah, markdown images are proxied on web during parsing phase which for comments happens on frontend (proxied url is obtained through `/beatmapsets/discussions/media-url?url=...`)

edit: it's only for chat and beatmap discussion but the principle is the same. raw markdown has the original url and only proxied during parsing - either by backend (returning raw html) or frontend
Hmm, right. We need to be doing that in the client then 💦

> No image should ever be requested directly from a third party domain

I don't know how hard this would be, but I think the possibility of this should be fundamentally prevented, e.g. with a whitelist for osu! server connections
there's a PR fixing this already, no counsel required

review_comments: How am I supposed to use these tests? Run locally and check console output? If so, mark them as not-CI-runnable.
They are meant for local testing only, will mark them as ignored.
That's fine, but I still don't know the expected outcome of each test. Local tests are only useful if it's easy for the person running them to know what they are looking for.
I've rewrote the tests to assert the end behaviour. I've intentionally left it as CI runnable since there's no reason not to, unless it's bad to have a test which depends on external lookups.
